website.note: Corporate site lists FDA-cleared SaMD products (Heartflow One platform: Roadmap Analysis, FFRCT Analysis, Plaque Analysis, PCI Navigator). No /pipeline page exists; site emphasizes commercial deployments and peer-reviewed validation studies rather than a drug-style pipeline.

ctgov.note: All Heartflow-sponsored studies on ClinicalTrials.gov are observational/validation studies of FDA-cleared software-as-a-medical-device, not interventional drug or device Phase 1-3 trials.

components.name: Roadmap Analysis
components.description: AI-driven CCTA reading tool for fast, consistent detection of coronary artery disease.

components.name: FFRCT Analysis
components.description: Non-invasive assessment of coronary blood flow / fractional flow reserve to guide revascularization decisions.

components.name: Plaque Analysis
components.description: Quantification and characterization of coronary plaque for risk stratification and disease management.
components.regulatory_status: FDA-cleared (commercial); supported by ACC/AHA scientific statements; AHA 2025 late-breaking data presented.

components.name: PCI Navigator
components.description: Pre-procedural planning tool for interventional cardiologists.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Heartflow is a medical-device / software-as-a-medical-device (SaMD) company commercializing FDA-cleared AI tools for coronary artery disease analysis (Heartflow One platform). It has no proprietary drug pipeline and no active interventional Phase 1/2/3 device trials of its own; sponsored studies are post-market validation / outcomes research.
